He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

people.name: Gishpa
people.line: An overseer of the temple servants during Nehemiah's time.

people.name: Ziha
people.line: Family of temple servants living on the Ophel

translations.web: But the temple servants lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
translations.bsb: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, with Ziha and Gishpa over them.
translations.kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
translations.asv: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
